llm.summary: The skill's files and instructions generally match a local multi‑partition memory system, but there are mismatches (notably implied LLM/network usage and automatic skill-generation) that are not declared and deserve a manual review before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (秘书式多分区记忆) align with the provided scripts: search/indexing, consolidation, capacity management, conflict detection, user modeling, cross-session loading, and an auto-skill generator. The code reads/writes a memory/ workspace and implements the advertised features.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and scripts confine operations to a workspace memory directory (default /root/.openclaw/workspace/memory) and describe searching, summarizing, archiving, and injecting context into prompts — which fits the stated purpose. However, several modules reference an LLM summarizer (fts5_index.LLMSummarizer) and an auto_skill_generator that can create new Skill files; these behaviors expand the runtime scope (potential outbound network calls and self‑modifying behavior) but are not documented in requires.env or in the high‑level SKILL.md triggers.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or external downloads are used. This is an instruction + code bundle intended to run in the agent environment; nothing in the manifest pulls code from third‑party URLs during install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, yet code paths import and use an LLMSummarizer (fts5_index) which likely requires API credentials or network access. The default MEMORY_DIR is /root/.openclaw/workspace/memory (writing/reading files there) but this path was not declared as a required config path. Auto skill generation implies the ability to write new skill files and possibly register them — neither credential nor permission requirements are documented. Missing declaration of needed API keys and the implicit write access to the agent workspace are disproportionate to what the SKILL.md explicitly states.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and normal model invocation are used (no forced always-on). The skill writes multiple state and archive files inside the memory workspace (expected for a memory manager). The auto_skill_generator component introduces write/self-modification capability (generating skill files), which elevates persistence/privilege and should be reviewed — but there is no evidence it modifies other skills' configurations automatically.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance:
What to check before installing:
- Review fts5_index.py and any LLMSummarizer implementation to confirm whether they call external APIs (OpenAI, Claude, or other endpoints) and which environment variables (API keys) they expect. These keys are not declared in the skill metadata.
- Inspect scripts/skill-creator/auto_skill_generator.py to see exactly what 'generate' and 'register' do. If it writes new skill files or attempts to register them automatically, consider disabling automatic generation or running the generator only after manual review.
- Note the default MEMORY_DIR (/root/.openclaw/workspace/memory): the skill will read/write many files there (memory.md, archive/, .state files). If you install, set OPENCLAW_MEMORY_DIR to an isolated directory you control and review created files.
- Run the scripts in 'dry-run' or verbose modes first (many scripts support --dry-run or --check flags) to observe behavior without making changes.
- If you cannot audit fts5_index and auto_skill_generator fully, run the skill in a sandboxed environment with egress network blocked to detect any hidden outbound requests.
- If you proceed, restrict any LLM API keys to least‑privilege, and do not provide credentials the skill does not explicitly need.

Confidence note: some files were truncated in the bundle (fts5_index.py and the auto_skill_generator are large and not fully shown). Full source review of those two modules would likely change the assessment (increase or decrease concern).
